newsitem.title: USA: C.H. Heist says Ablest unit in acquisition.
newsitem.headline: C.H. Heist says Ablest unit in acquisition.

text.p: C.H. Heist Corp said Monday that its temporary staffing unit, Ablest Service Corp, had acquired Solution Source Inc, an Atlanta-based information technology staffing provider.
The terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The company said that Solution Source, which had 1996 annualized sales of about $3.2 million, will be combined with Ablest's information technology division - Tech Resource Group.

Heist has two major lines of business: temporary staffing and industrial maintenance. It has announced its intentions to spin off the Ablest staffing subsidiary, combined with an initial public offering, during 1997.
